title: Luxury Private Wine Tasting Tour to Guadalupe Valley from San Diego
includes: Wine tastings and cheese platter and tour of the wine making process.
Drinks during lunch and gratuities (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We offer the best wine tasting tours to Guadalupe Valley starting from San Diego! You will visit three artisan wine makers in the heart of the valley where you will enjoy tastings of delicious reds, whites and roses. You will get a cheese platter to go with your wine at the second winery. Additionally, you will experience a tour of the wine making process and enjoy a succulent BajaMed style lunch at Finca Altozano. Tour starts at 9:00am and back in San Diego by 7:30pm. Times are approximations, wineries and restaurant subject to change based on availability and weather conditions. This is a Private tour. You will have a private van for your party. No strangers. Minimum of six passengers per booking needed. If you have a request for a particular winery you want to visit let us know and we will try to include it in your itinerary.
